flawless: We phased in, struck, and phased out. You never laid a hand on us.
Raiders of the tides take what they like. Today we took your pride.
solid: You caught us between tides. A few cuts, nothing more.
The sea takes its toll on us all. Today it took a little from both of us.
close: We were nearly beached! The others will tease us for weeks.
Half our raiding party is out of phase and the rest are dizzy. Close one.
